name: Rancho Cantina
cuisine: Wood-fired Californio Mexican, tequila and mezcal bar
tagline: Ranch-to-table cuisine has arrived in Danville
description: Rancho Cantina opened on the corner of Hartz and Church in August 2026, the second location of the family-owned Lafayette original run by Danville residents Nico and Alice Tzikas. Executive Chef Carlos Navarro cooks over an almond-wood grill: Vaquero platters, carne asada, brick chicken, a 32 oz Cowboy Cut ribeye for two and whole fried branzino next to tacos, enchiladas and sizzling fajita skillets. The bigger Danville room made space for a real bar built on tequila and mezcal, with corner patio seating on Hartz.
hours_note: Walk-ins welcome. Parties of 9 or more, call the restaurant.

happy_hour.text: No posted happy hour window. Day-of-week specials instead: Taco Tuesday with $5 tacos and a $10 Rancho Margarita, and Margarita Monday deals when announced.

late_night.text: Kitchen and bar run together until 10 PM Sunday to Thursday and 11 PM Friday and Saturday, the latest close on the corner most nights. The mezcal list is the natural last stop.

name: Incontro Ristorante
cuisine: Regional Italian in the historic Hartz House
description: Incontro has served regional Italian cooking in the c. 1910 Hartz House since 2011, across stone-walled dining rooms, a covered veranda strung with lights and a garden patio with fire pits. Bread, pasta and desserts are made in house: the fontina-cream gnocchi is the dish people come back for, next to lobster ravioli, lasagne, a four-pasta Chef's Taste of Italy and secondi like skirt steak on saffron risotto. There is a full bar inside and out, live music on the patio in the warm months, a Sunday brunch buffet, a 16-seat Wine Room for private dinners and tray catering.
hours_note: Closed Mondays. Brunch buffet Saturday 12 to 3 and Sunday 10 to 2.

happy_hour.text: No posted happy hour. Summer Fridays bring the Spritz Series on the patio bar, 5 to 10 PM: one spritz paired with an appetizer for $20.

late_night.text: Dinner until 10 PM Friday and Saturday, 9 PM other nights. The digestivi list (Averna, Fernet, grappa, limoncello, vin santo, ports) and seven house-made desserts make it the corner's classic last course.

name: Kaia's Island Kitchen & Tiki Bar
cuisine: Hawaiian comfort food and a classic tiki bar
tagline: Come for the food, stay for the vibe, return for the magic
description: Kaia's opened in spring 2025 in the old Vine and Spirits space, built by longtime Danville restaurateur Randy Negi around family trips to Hawaii and named for his granddaughter. The kitchen does Spam musubi, poke crisps and bowls, loco moco, chicken katsu, kalbi beef and a shareable Hula Pie. The tiki program runs from a '44 Mai Tai to Zombies, Jungle Birds, Navy Grog and rum flights under thatch, carved tikis and a sunset mural, with a garden patio, live Hawaiian music on Fridays and a bar that stays open an hour after the kitchen.
hours_note: Kitchen closes one hour before the bar. Tables held for walk-ins Friday and Saturday 6 to 8 PM.

happy_hour.text: Aloha Hour Monday to Friday 3 to 6 PM: $6 drafts, $3 off wine and select tiki cocktails, $8 to $12 bites. Mai Tai Mondays all day.

late_night.text: The bar pours an hour past the kitchen: until 11 PM Friday and Saturday, 10 PM Wednesday and Thursday. Hula Pie and Dole Whip close the night.

name: Danville Harvest
cuisine: Farm-to-table New American with a serious whiskey bar
description: Danville Harvest, family owned, has cooked seasonal Bay Area produce in the c. 1903 Eddy House since 2016, directly across Hartz from Rancho Cantina. Executive Chef Noe Briseno runs weekday lunch, weekend brunch, a daily happy hour and dinner built on shared plates, short ribs and the Danville Burger. The bar claims the largest whiskey selection in the Tri-Valley, with whiskey flights, a build-your-own Manhattan program, wines poured in two sizes and a zero-proof cocktail list.
hours_note: Lunch weekdays 11:30 to 3, brunch weekends 10 to 3, happy hour daily 3 to 5, dinner from 4. Weekend closing times vary by source (9:30 or 10 PM), so call for a late table.

happy_hour.text: Daily 3 to 5 PM: $5 bites, $10 cocktails, $5 drafts, $9 wines, $20 whiskey flight.

late_night.text: Dinner ends 8:30 most nights and about 9:30 Friday and Saturday. Start here early and cross the street for the nightcap.
